title: fix(deps): drop bottleneck, its last release holds a require cycle
description:
## .what
`bottleneck@2.19.5` (its last release) holds a require cycle, `lib/Bottleneck.js <-> lib/Group.js`. the declapract `test:lint:cycles` check (dpdm, node_modules included) reds every consumer that imports this package, since the package index reaches bottleneck. the stone rule forbids a prod-dep exclude, so consumers hold a named exception until this lands.

## .ask
drop the `bottleneck` dependency for a cycle-free limiter (an in-house queue, or `p-limit`), same contract; and bump `helpful-errors` to >=1.7 and `domain-objects` to >=0.34, whose cycles are fixed.

first seen in rhachet-roles-bhrain `.route/v2026_11_19.declapract.upgrade`, stone 3.1 (fulcrum F4).
